description: The checks a quote must pass to be marked final: a form, and for each case the values typed into its sheets, the tables their price gave (null for no price) and every check with whether it passes and the rows failing it. quoteChecks in frontend/src/utils/quoteChecks.ts is held to them on the values and the price, and quote_checks in src/haute/_workbench_checks.py on the quote as the store writes it.

outputs.name: premium_ok
outputs.label: Premium check
outputs.validation_message: The premium is below the minimum

cases.name: a quote passing every rule, the hidden Trade's left out
nothing typed and no price: required inputs and one-row outputs fail, a tick box among them, empty passes a range and allowed values, tables without rows pass
a required input shown and left empty fails
text of spaces alone is no value, and an unticked box in a row holding anything is one
a number below its range, one above, and one below a range with no top
a range's ends are within it, and zero is a value
a value that is none of the allowed values, and an Integer compared as a number
an Integer that is none of the allowed values
a validation holding false fails, and a required output left null
a validation the pipeline leaves unfilled fails
a many-row table's failing rows are named by their index, each rule its own rows
a row left blank between two typed is no row, and the rows keep their numbers on the sheet
a table of outputs alone is checked on the rows pricing gave
an index of values names its rows by their values
a typed index names its rows by the value typed, read as its type
a value typed into a column the sheets hide alone makes no row of a one-row table: its tick box holds nothing
a many-row table's row holding a value in a hidden column alone is no row
the same row is one once its column shows
